sequence.cn: 你听说过特种兵旅游吗？
sequence.py: Nǐ tīngshuōguo tè zhǒng bīng lǚyóu ma?
sequence.en: Have you heard of "special forces" travel?

sequence.cn: 特种兵本来是军人，现在也用来说一种旅游方式。
sequence.py: Tè zhǒng bīng běnlái shì jūnrén, xiànzài yě yòng lái shuō yì zhǒng lǚyóu fāngshì.
sequence.en: 特种兵 originally means a special-forces soldier; now it also describes a way of traveling.

sequence.cn: 花最少的钱，用最短的时间，看最多的地方。
sequence.py: Huā zuì shǎo de qián, yòng zuì duǎn de shíjiān, kàn zuì duō de dìfang.
sequence.en: Spend the least money, take the least time, and see the most places.

sequence.cn: 我表妹上个月去西安，来了一场特种兵旅行。
sequence.py: Wǒ biǎomèi shàng ge yuè qù Xī'ān, lái le yì chǎng tè zhǒng bīng lǚxíng.
sequence.en: Last month my cousin went to Xi'an and pulled off a full special-forces trip.

sequence.cn: 她坐夜车去，坐夜车回，连酒店都没订。
sequence.py: Tā zuò yèchē qù, zuò yèchē huí, lián jiǔdiàn dōu méi dìng.
sequence.en: She took the night train there and the night train back — she didn't even book a hotel.

sequence.cn: 两天走了八个景点，微信步数三万八。
sequence.py: Liǎng tiān zǒu le bā ge jǐngdiǎn, wēixìn bùshù sān wàn bā.
sequence.en: Eight sights in two days — thirty-eight thousand steps on WeChat.

sequence.cn: 回来那天早上，她拖着箱子直接去上课，眼睛都睁不开。
sequence.py: Huílái nà tiān zǎoshang, tā tuōzhe xiāngzi zhíjiē qù shàngkè, yǎnjing dōu zhēng bù kāi.
sequence.en: The morning she got back she dragged her suitcase straight to class, barely able to keep her eyes open.

sequence.cn: 我问她西安好不好玩，她想了半天说：照片挺好看的。
sequence.py: Wǒ wèn tā Xī'ān hǎo bu hǎo wán, tā xiǎng le bàntiān shuō: zhàopiàn tǐng hǎokàn de.
sequence.en: I asked if Xi'an was fun; she thought for a long while and said: the photos turned out nice.

sequence.cn: 可是这个周末，她又买好了去成都的票。
sequence.py: Kěshì zhège zhōumò, tā yòu mǎi hǎo le qù Chéngdū de piào.
sequence.en: But for this weekend, she's already bought her ticket to Chengdu.
